description: Find the action for a job, by the person's own words ("work email of a person", "dentists in a city") or by an action id. Use it first for any one-off data job. When a ready-made recipe fits the ask, the answer offers it first. Each result has its id, what it gives, whether it is ready and its price rule. Nothing fits: the answer says so and catalog_request asks Ahel to add it. Free; changes nothing. NOT for: the exact price of one run, which is capability_inspect.

kind.description: Optional: only actions (the value "task") or only provider tools.

platform.description: Optional platform id (companies, google, image-gen): only its items; with no query, its whole shelf.

query.description: The job in the person's own words, or an exact action id such as companies.enrich.

status.description: Optional: only items in this state.

name: capability_search
title: Find an action
